notes: Generic PC power-supply documentation references, not purchasable manufacturer models or CAD assets. Dimension axes, package variants, and omitted clearances are explicit. Intel guide 2.1a (document 336521, 2023-11-01) is the reviewed source; its drawings remain linked rather than copied.

products.compatibility_notes: Generic documentation reference, not manufacturer-certified fit geometry. The 140 mm reference depth is not a universal ATX PSU depth. Verify the selected PSU's actual body, mounting-hole locations, fan/grille projections, connector and switch layout, cable bend space, and ventilation before designing a printed case. No wattage, electrical conformity, exact SKU, price, or inventory stock is inferred.

products.compatibility_notes: Generic documentation reference, not manufacturer-certified fit geometry.
